svg.title: Stretch Posture Coach - visual abstract
svg.desc: Sense with the Stretch 3 cameras, understand posture, falls and the room, act with spoken coaching, follow mode and fall alarms, and share through a live web view, reports, VR telepresence and phone notifications.
svg.text: Full-body biomechanics, spoken coaching and fall safety on a Hello Robot Stretch 3. Runs on the robot, no cloud.

g.text: Bring your chin back so your

no posture tips to someone who fell
RGB-D in true stereo, head follows

svg.text: On the robot: NUC12 i5 CPU · Python 3.11 + uv · one-command install
